integrity: All universal formulas follow from explicit Dirichlet monomial moments. The packaged checker independently expands the relevant weighted polynomials with exact rational arithmetic on multiple finite data sets.
scientific_limitations: The formulas assume ordinary Dirichlet(1,...,1) Bayesian-bootstrap weights.
The variance functional is the population variance of the random weighted empirical distribution.
An equivalent identity in older unindexed Dirichlet-moment or bootstrap literature cannot be excluded.
title: Exact Bayesian-bootstrap coupling of weighted mean and variance
